items.title: Running man (side) — does the stance foot hold?
items.look: Before: 14 of 31 key poses had NO foot planted, so the body floated and the feet drifted. Now every pose has its support foot planted, alternating once per step. The side-view feet were also drawn ~11° toe-up before; now a flat foot is flat. What changed is only WHICH foot is pinned to the floor (now from the weight: the foot carrying the body is planted, the free one may leave). The pelvis does not move over the foot yet and there is no sink — that is Task 2. Flip between 'before' and 'now' a few times.
items.question: Does the body hang less — does a foot hold the floor on each step? Are the feet flat on the floor now? Anything worse?
